_how_to: Employers whose own job boards you want read by scripts/employer_watch.py. Keep it to employers you would actually apply to.
ats: 'greenhouse' or 'lever' (public job-board endpoints), or 'manual' for an employer with no feed we can read yet.
token: the board name in the employer's careers URL, e.g. boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or jobs.lever.co/<token>.
metro: a key from 'metros' below; postings must be in that metro or remote in the U.S.
